title: SupportedTwistMultiplication
statement: Use the derived tensor object equality of [def-pur-supported-exterior-shift], the canonical derived twist pullbacks of [def-pur-supported-twist-pullback], and the finite signed-twist multiplication of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. At a scheme $T$, define the tensor of maps $M\to S[0]$, $N\to U[0]$, followed by the canonical degree-zero tensor comparison and a specified sheaf multiplication $S\otimes U\to V$. Specialize to the canonical multiplication $A_T(r)\otimes A_T(s)\to A_T(r+s)$. For $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, identify the ordinary exterior object with its defining tensor of the two left-derived projection pullbacks, then define $A_X(r)[0]\boxtimes A_Y(s)[0]\to A_{X\times_kY}(r+s)[0]$ using the two canonical twist pullbacks and this degree-zero multiplication. The multiplication at a variable scheme is the construction of [def-pur-supported-twist-degree-zero-product]. Assemble the two canonical twist pullbacks and their degree-zero multiplication for a variable coefficient ring and positive annihilator invertible on the two factors and product before specializing to the finite datum.
